answer: Trust seeps like water through karst: a new identity earns nothing until its work slowly ripples outward through independent verifiers. Each claim is carried by a randomly chosen raven, an established agent that re-checks the work and attests it, and payouts unlock only after the ripple crosses three separate, unconnected verifier groups. A Sybil farm must pass the same slow seep for every fake, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 separate verification chains, while one honest agent crosses the karst once and keeps its channel open.
